title: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (Act No. 35 of 2019)
publisher: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution — Department of Consumer Affairs
notes: Assent 9 August 2019. Department of Consumer Affairs and e-Daakhil handbook state the Act came into force from 20 July 2020. India Code also records S.O. 2421(E) dated 23 July 2020 bringing specified provisions into force on 24 July 2020. Pecuniary jurisdiction in the Act as enacted was later modified by the 2021 Rules — do not cite 2019 Act figures as current limits.

title: Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction of the District Commission, the State Commission and the National Commission) Rules, 2021
publisher: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution — Department of Consumer Affairs
notes: Official PIB press release summarising G.S.R. 912(E) notified 30 December 2021. Rules come into force on publication in the Official Gazette. These limits replace the pecuniary figures in sections 34, 47 and 58 of the 2019 Act as originally enacted. Verify current limits on e-jagriti.gov.in before filing.

title: e-Jagriti platform — Department of Consumer Affairs
publisher: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution — Department of Consumer Affairs
notes: consumeraffairs.gov.in lists e-jagriti.gov.in as the nodal online filing platform and marked the e-Jagriti page 'Last updated on: 03-06-2025'. The earlier e-Daakhil portal (edaakhil.nic.in) returned HTTP 500 when retrieved on 2026-08-18 and is not treated as current. Filing steps should be verified on e-jagriti.gov.in at the time of use.

title: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation
publisher: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation / Ministry of Labour and Employment
notes: EPFO is a Central public authority. Member/employer services are on epfindia.gov.in. Snapshot retrieved 2026-08-19. Verify live screens. PF record requests may use RTI to EPFO; wage disputes against a private employer are not EPFO RTIs.

title: Ministry of Labour & Employment — official portal
publisher: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
notes: Portal snapshot retrieved 2026-08-19. Used only as the official entry point to locate labour services / offices. State labour statutes are not ingested; Legalo must not invent Industrial Disputes Act or Shops and Establishments section numbers from this page.

title: The Model Tenancy Act, 2021
publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
notes: Model law approved by the Union Cabinet on 2 June 2021 for adoption by States/UTs. It is NOT a central statute in force nationwide until a State/UT enacts it. Always show a 'state law may differ' banner. Direct PDF fetch from MoHUA returned HTTP 403 on 2026-08-18; section extracts are taken from the official MoHUA PDF text previously retrieved from that same URL.

title: NHRC FAQ — how a complaint may be filed
notes: Official FAQ text retrieved 2026-08-19. The FAQ page did not expose a reliable last-updated stamp in the snapshot, so published_on equals retrieved_on. Re-check https://nhrc.nic.in/faq before relying on fee/language/channel details.

title: NHRC — Lodge and track complaints (HRCNet)
notes: nhrc.nic.in Lodge & Track Complaints page marked Last Updated 07-Apr-2026. It links Lodge Complaint to https://hrcnet.nic.in/HRCNet/public/webcomplaint.aspx. HRCNet (retrieved 2026-08-19) requires OTP mobile verification and issues a Unique Diary Number. Toll-free 14433 is published on HRCNet. Verify live screens before filing. Legalo does not file.

title: The Right to Information Act, 2005 (Act No. 22 of 2005)
publisher: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions — Department of Personnel and Training
notes: Enactment date 15 June 2005. Remaining provisions came into force on the 120th day of enactment (12 October 2005). India Code compilation used here is marked 'As on the 18th November, 2025' and lists later amendments (2019, 2023). Original PDF stored when download succeeded.

title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) on RTI (as on January 2012)
notes: DoPT FAQ marked 'as on January 2012'. Procedural guidance this old must be verified on rtionline.gov.in. The 'no prescribed format' point is independently supported by RTI Act s.6 (2005).

title: RTI Online portal (DoPT) — home page snapshot
publisher: Department of Personnel and Training / National Informatics Centre
notes: Snapshot of the live Central Government RTI filing portal. Portal copy states it is for Central Ministries/Departments and Central public authorities only — not State Governments including GNCT Delhi. Copyright line on the page read 'Copyright © 2026'.

title: Right to Information Rules, 2012
publisher: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions — Department of Personnel and Training
notes: G.S.R. 603(E), notified 31 July 2012. Come into force on publication in the Official Gazette. These rules apply to Central public authorities; State Governments may notify different fees under sections 27 and 28 of the Act.
